brief:
The Palestinian death toll from Israel's war on Gaza has surpassed 74,000, according to the Ministry of Health in Gaza. Muhammad Shehada assessed Trump's Gaza plan one year after its announcement, characterizing it as "buying more time for the genocide," Democracy Now! reported.

The death toll figure comes as international attention focuses on diplomatic initiatives and their humanitarian impact in the territory.

title: Gaza death toll exceeds 74,000 as Trump plan assessed one year on
